title: SharePoint and OneDrive: updated search experience with Copilot Search
summary: The rollout dates, administrator deadline, default state and documented Restricted Content Discovery controls are supported. The assertion that search is how most people find files is unsubstantiated and should be narrowed; licensing and deferral instructions for the new SharePoint and OneDrive surface remain documentation gaps.

claims.claim: Restricted Content Discovery is at SharePoint admin center > Sites > Active sites > site > Settings > Restrict content from Microsoft Copilot.
claims.quote: In the SharePoint admin center, expand Sites and select Active sites. Select the site you want to configure. Open the Settings tab, and then turn Restrict content from Microsoft Copilot on.

claims.claim: Restricted Content Discovery is an existing site-level discovery restriction, not a switch that defers the updated search interface.
claims.quote: Restricted Content Discovery is a site-level setting. When you turn on the setting, Microsoft 365 search systems propagate it so that content from the site doesn't appear in organization-wide discovery experiences.

claims.claim: The Copilot Search management page describes Restricted Content Discovery as excluding sites from organization-wide search and Copilot answers unless users own or recently interacted with content.
claims.quote: This setting prevents these sites from appearing in organization-wide search results and Microsoft Copilot answers unless a user owns or has recently interacted with content on those sites.

claims.claim: Restricted Content Discovery affects organization-wide search experiences such as SharePoint home.
claims.quote: Restricted Content Discovery affects organization-wide search experiences (SharePoint home, Office.com, Bing) and Microsoft Copilot discovery scenarios, including experiences that rely on tenant-wide content discovery.

claims.claim: Restricted Content Discovery does not affect searches originating from site context.
claims.quote: Restricted Content Discovery doesn't affect searches that originate from site context or other intelligent experiences such as Microsoft 365 Feed and Recommendations.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Risk assessment / Data exposure; Governance controls
claims.claim: Restricted Content Discovery applies to SharePoint sites and is not supported for OneDrive sites.
claims.quote: You can only apply this feature to SharePoint sites. It's not supported for OneDrive sites.

claims.claim: The Restricted Content Discovery page includes recently interacted files in its restriction, differing from the recent-interaction exception quoted from Copilot Search management.
claims.quote: Restricted Content Discovery helps you limit discovery of content from specific SharePoint sites, including recently interacted files, in organization-wide search results and Microsoft Copilot responses while those reviews are taking place.

claims.claim: Restricted Content Discovery changes can take a long time to propagate for large sites.
claims.quote: For sites with more than 500,000 items, an update to Restricted Content Discovery could take more than a week to fully process and reflect in search and Copilot experiences.

claims.claim: Restricted Content Discovery is a temporary governance control for reviewing and right-sizing access.
claims.quote: Restricted Content Discovery is designed as a temporary governance control that gives organizations time to review and right-size access while continuing their Copilot deployment.
